title: 2023 Panini Select #NMB-ABR A.J. Brown Philadelphia Eagles Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Panini Select trading card features A.J. Brown of the Philadelphia Eagles in the Select Numbers insert set. The card is part of the National Football League (NFL) set and has a card number of NMB-ABR. It was manufactured by Panini in 2023 and has a print run of SP. 

The card is a sports trading card and belongs to the category of Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop. It does not have an autograph and is perfect for collectors who are looking for a unique addition to their collection. Get this rare card now and complete your set!
